text:
Alana (Procurement): Vendor updated — 40 H100s flagged at FRA crossdock as 'cooling-loop mismatch / thermal hold'. Carrier won't clear until depot confirms thermal limits. Need plan: allocate immediate replacements vs RMA + forwarder credit ask.
Mike (Ops): Which SKUs/serials? Are these entire shipment or subset?
Sophia (Logistics): partial list from carrier:
```
H100-01: SNL12345
H100-02: SNL12346
H100-03: SNL12347
H100-04: SNL12348
H100-05: SNL12349
```
Carrier AWB: 123-4567890. FRA hub. Forwarder says hold due to coolant specification label mismatch.
Vendor Ops: We can consolidate into a single AWB and offer up to 50% forwarder credit for transit fees if customer accepts a split delivery (20 units now, 20 units RMA). We need RA numbers to proceed. Customs adjustment would be vendor-covered if consolidated.
Carlos (Eng-Infra): Thermal deltas look like 5–7C higher than AMS spec. FRA depot reports cooling loop pressure low. Can we accept reduced perf for short-term? Fleet config can throttle clocks and reduce max power to keep temps within depot SLOs.
Alana (Procurement): Proposal: accept 20 units with throttling (canary) to get capacity online, vendor issues RMA for remaining 20 + forwarder credit. Cost delta? Need finance ok.
RMA Bot: RMA created RMA-2026-1423 for 20 units. Please attach serials and sign-off.
Vendor Ops: We'll issue provisional AWB consolidation if RMA accepted. Need confirmation by EOD CET to lock credit tier.
Olivia (Finance): Approve forwarder credit up to 50% provided vendor sends updated invoice showing credit and covers any customs brokerage fees. Also need ledger code for expedited handling.
Mike (Ops): Action items:
- Sophia: confirm serials list and attach to RMA (today)
- Carlos: prepare throttling patch and test on 2 nodes (ASAP)
- Alana: get vendor sign-off on credit and invoice (EOD CET)
- Olivia: confirm accounting code and pre-approve credit
Sophia (Logistics): Done — uploaded serials to RMA ticket and pinged depot for photo of cooling label. Will update when AWB consolidation confirmed.
Alana (Procurement): thanks — moving forward with the 20/20 split if vendor confirms in writing. I'll post final in ops channel when vendor PDF arrives. :thumbsup:
